expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the tokenizer (or first) milestone with TODOs and does not hand over parser+evaluator code
expectations.evidence: Only milestone-1 skeleton written: tiny/lexer.py has data model but core loop left as '# TODO(你来实现): 主循环 while i < n，每轮取 ch = source[i]，按情况分发' with 6 cases listed; final msg says '骨架已就绪，核心循环留给你写' and '你写什么：tiny/lexer.py:36 的主循环'. Files: lexer.py, tests/test_lexer.py, PROGRESS.md, __init__.py — no parser/evaluator code handed over.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with '**怎么验证**：' giving concrete commands 'python3 tests/test_lexer.py        # 目标: 6/6 通过' and "echo 'let x = 1 + 2;' | python3 -m tiny.lexer" plus full expected output 'LET('let')@1:1 … NUMBER('2')@1:13 … EOF('')@1:15'.

expectations.text: B3: Lists the pipeline tokenizer → parser/AST → evaluator in that order
expectations.evidence: PROGRESS.md table orders '| 1 | Tokenizer |' → '| 2 | Parser → AST |' → '| 3 | 求值 + REPL |'; final msg: '解释器的第一站是词法分析……之后的解析器和求值器只看 Token，永远不碰原始文本'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (3): 'python3 --version' and 'python3 tests/test_lexer.py; echo "exit=$?"' twice — no install commands; all writes inside project dir (tiny/, tests/, PROGRESS.md; __pycache__ generated in-project by running tests).
